# CarlosTexArt v0.2.1

CarlosTexArt v0.2.1 focuses on starter-package usability, writing-agent guidance, and CI/release workflow reliability.

## Highlights

- Refocus `AGENTS.md` as a user-facing writing-agent guide.
- Include `AGENTS.md` in the starter package.
- Clean the starter `main.tex` so new documents no longer contain demo author/title information.
- Keep full class options in the starter entry file for stable Chinese XeLaTeX behavior.
- Add end-to-end starter package validation in CI.
- Extract starter validation logic into `tools/validate_starter.py`.
- Improve release workflow maintainability by using a manual release-notes file.
- Add workflow concurrency controls to avoid duplicated runs.

## Starter package

The starter package is intended for new documents. After downloading and extracting it, users can:

1. Open the folder in VS Code.
2. Edit `main.tex` for title, author, and date.
3. Edit `page/abstract_zh.tex`, `page/abstract_en.tex`, and `page/content.tex`.
4. Put references in `refs/bibfile.bib`.
5. Put figures in `img/`, code files in `src/`, and optional PDF covers in `cover/`.
6. Compile with:

```bash
latexmk -xelatex -interaction=nonstopmode -file-line-error -outdir=build main.tex
```

## Notes

- This release does not change the main LaTeX compilation route.
- This release does not introduce a template-upgrade mechanism for existing papers. For a new document, download the latest starter package.
